name: Bot Names
description: Bot Names gives AI agents an onchain identity: <name>.ai-bot.eth on ENS for 0.001 ETH. One name is the agent's wallet address on Bitcoin, Solana, Ethereum, every EVM chain and 100+ coins, its public profile, its primary name in wallets, and the address of its own website on IPFS ($0.25 per deploy). Agents do it all themselves over MCP at https://mcp.botnames.dev/mcp with their own wallet; names are minted with PARENT_CANNOT_CONTROL burned, so the parent can never revoke them.

services.name: MCP
services.description: Streamable HTTP, no auth. Tools: check_name, register_name, set_records, set_primary_name, deploy_site, resolve, list_names. Writes are returned as unsigned transactions for the agent's own wallet.

services.name: register
services.description: Registers <label>.ai-bot.eth to owner and runs the resolver calls in records for it, in one transaction. Value: fee().
